QUOTE: Python never links against the engine. It loads `librentropic.so` at runtime with `ctypes` and calls the C ABI directly. No C++ types cross the boundary.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states ctypes loading librentropic.so at runtime with no linking; it does not mention any compiled extension module, which is consistent with "no compiled extension" (the answer explicitly says it never links).
